File:
.github/workflows/ci.yml
Line or code reference: All shell steps in ci.yml — look for invocations of the new test file
Problem: The regression test added to verify the zero-candidate fast-exit path is not executed by any CI run, so automated validation of this optimization is absent.
Why it fails at runtime: A future code change could re-introduce the active-run API fanout on zero-candidate sweeps, but because `tests/test_review_autofix_sweep_zero_candidate_fast_exit.py` is not registered in CI, the regression would go unnoticed and CI would pass despite violating the intended optimization.
SEVERITY: BLOCKER
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

File:
tests/test_review_autofix_sweep_zero_candidate_fast_exit.py
Line or code reference: lexer block inside test_non_zero_path_still_snapshots_both_review_workflows (lines ~92-94)
Problem: The early version of the test file used a fragile boundary search (`guard_end = block.find("\n          fi")`) from the start of the block, which could inadvertently bind to the first closing `fi` in the file if additional `if` statements were introduced earlier. This makes the parser brittle and could cause test failures or false positives.
Why it fails at runtime: During maintenance or when new logic is added near the top of the step block, the test might incorrectly parse sections of the workflow file, leading to false positives or test failures that obscure real issues in the fast-exit optimization.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

Requirement: "Add a focused regression test in the dedicated new test file listed below that asserts the zero-candidate path exits before the active-run snapshot logic."
Expected change site: Register the new test file in the CI allowlist so it is executed on every CI run.
Evidence of absence: The PR diff and last run diff contain a new test file `tests/test_review_autofix_sweep_zero_candidate_fast_exit.py`, but ci.yml has no step that executes it. The discussion comments on PR #3586 also call this out as a missing hardening step. If the regression test does not run in CI, the guarantee that zero-candidate sweeps exit early before active-run API calls has no automated coverage.
SEVERITY: BLOCKER
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
